name: Fabric Data Engineering
sku: The Data Engineering workload of Microsoft Fabric (lakehouse, Spark notebooks and Spark job definitions) on a Fabric capacity. Fabric Data Science is not scored.

transform.code-transform.note: Apache Spark for large datasets. Notebooks in Python, R and Scala carry ingestion, preparation and transformation code, and Spark job definitions submit that code to a Spark cluster.

transform.stream-processing.note: Spark job definitions can submit batch or streaming jobs to the Spark cluster. Continuous event processing is centred on Real-Time Intelligence, which is scored separately.

bands.note: Interactive notebooks with live code, visualisations and narrative text, running in the Fabric web experience.

presentation.tagline: Spark notebooks, job definitions and a lakehouse over OneLake.
